scope: Changed-only descriptive prerequisite QA/docs check; original runtime/software PASS preserved; no runtime/provider/database calls or private export
args:
import copy, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker
packet_path = Path("qa/packets/goal-t014-actual-prerequisites.json")
schema_path = Path("qa/packets/goal-t014-actual-input.schema.json")
packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
schema = json.loads(schema_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=FormatChecker())
expected = set(schema["properties"]["gates"]["items"]["properties"]["id"]["enum"])
def intake_review(value):
    validator.validate(value)
    ids = [gate["id"] for gate in value["gates"]]
    if len(ids) != len(set(ids)) or set(ids) != expected:
        raise ValueError("review requires every gate exactly once")
intake_review(packet)
assert len(expected) == 10
assert all(g["status"] == "UNRESOLVED" and not g["evidence"] for g in packet["gates"])
actual = packet["actualInputs"]
assert all(v is None or v == [] for v in actual.values())
assert packet["acceptedBaseline"]["win"] == "per-counsellor majority, >50% preferred, over 100+ real questions"
assert packet["acceptedBaseline"]["internalStreakCount"] is None
candidate = packet["candidateSources"]
assert len(candidate) == 1 and candidate[0]["status"] == "CANDIDATE_ONLY"
assert candidate[0]["exactText"] is None and candidate[0]["humanReviewEvidence"] is None
assert "inspected by AI" in candidate[0]["aiExposure"] and "cannot prove" in candidate[0]["aiExposure"]
transcript = Path(candidate[0]["reference"])
assert hashlib.sha256(transcript.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == candidate[0]["fileSha256"]
lines = transcript.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines()
assert lines[70].startswith("[45:14] Devesh:") and lines[68].startswith("[45:14]")
assert lines[72].startswith("[46:20] Priyamvada:")
assert "VERDICT: HOLD" in Path("qa/verdicts/goal-t013.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
assert "**Status:** checked-PASS" in Path(packet["softwareHandshake"]["manifest"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
verdict = Path(packet["softwareHandshake"]["verdict"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
assert "Cycle checked: 0" in verdict and "FULL TASK T-014: HOLD" in verdict
negative = []
def case(name, change):
    value = copy.deepcopy(packet)
    change(value)
    negative.append((name, value))
case("invented authorization", lambda p: p.update(authorizationState="AUTHORIZED"))
case("invented full PASS", lambda p: p.update(fullTask="PASS"))
case("promoted gate", lambda p: p["gates"][0].update(status="COMPLETE"))
case("approved candidate", lambda p: p["candidateSources"][0].update(status="APPROVED"))
case("unknown approval flag", lambda p: p.update(humanApproved=True))
case("missing consent field", lambda p: p["actualInputs"].update(counsellors=[{}]))
case("invalid source", lambda p: p["candidateSources"][0].update(kind="synthetic"))
case("unverified evidence absent", lambda p: p["gates"][0].update(status="PROVIDED_NOT_VERIFIED"))
case("repeated gate ID", lambda p: p["gates"][1].update(id=p["gates"][0]["id"]))
refused = 0
for name, value in negative:
    try:
        intake_review(value)
    except Exception:
        refused += 1
    else:
        raise AssertionError("accepted negative case: " + name)
assert refused == len(negative)
print("T014_PREREQUISITE_REVIEW current=valid gates=10/10-unresolved adoptedQuestions=0 actualCounsellors=0 actualJudges=0 knownAIExposure=true negativeRefusals=%d/%d authorization=NOT_AUTHORIZED_TO_RUN fullTask=HOLD schemaUniqueGateRule=independent-review" % (refused, len(negative)))
semanticLimit: Repeated gate IDs are rejected by independent reviewer invariant, not by descriptive JSON schema alone. Schema validity never verifies participation or approval. Full task remains HOLD.
